correctness.rationale: Reconstructed lax team semantics as an edge-to-slot capacitated matching problem with two row slots and one column slot. Hall theorem is equivalent for every rectangle to |T∩(U×V)|≤2|U|+|V|. Inclusion-minimal failure forces 2a+b+1=|T|≤ab; within a,b≤4 only (a,b)=(3,4),(4,3),(4,4) are possible. The complete 13-cell omission condition is three distinct missing rows and not all one missing column; 11-cell and 12-cell cases are specified exact rectangles. Combinatorial enumeration gives 48+4+240=292. Independent complete enumeration of all 65,536 teams via rectangle criterion yielded 64,591 satisfying and 945 unsatisfying; minimal false histogram {11:48,12:4,13:240}. Enumeration confirms but Hall plus support proof establishes classification.
